question: Does the existing public Diller source chain close at least six RT force-controlled virgin constant-amplitude specimen→physical build/powder observations?
scope_boundary: Targeted local full-dissertation and official Diller source-chain revalidation only; no broad campaign search, fits, login, bypass or correspondence.

public_endpoints.access_instruction: Official page directs interested readers to the chair secretariat; it is a catalog, not a public thesis PDF.

dissertation_coverage.fulltext_keyword_inventory: pdf_keyword_coverage.json; includes batch, physical-build phrases, μnumeric IDs, equipment and mode/RT terms. Negative search alone is not used as proof.

close_read_sections.content: Contents: no standalone specimen inventory or separate experimental-build appendix.
Chapter6.2 integrates publication-specific methods; no manufacturing specimen crosswalk.
Publication4/5 summaries and author contributions; student thesis involvement is explicit, but no build/lot mapping.
Appendix is student thesis list and author publication list; exact P5 student leads identified.
P5 Methods and Tables1–3: manufacturing parameters, CT parameters, defect features, R.1 and stress ranges; no physical-build inventory, powder lot or mapping to μIDs.
P5 Tables4–5, results/captions and data availability: surface statistics and ML results, not a build crosswalk; data available by author request.

not_transferable_statements.reason: A36-fatigue-specimen build job is explicit, but it is the distinct strain-control campaign; cannot assign P5 μIDs to it.
78fatigue specimens in six treatment groups,192W/750mm/s and18Hz; different P5 manufacturing parameters, no exact specimen crosswalk. Singular build-plate wording is not transferable.
Two additional tensile build jobs and node fatigue tests; no μseries link.
Generic force-controlled S–N description is not an experiment-specific control-mode statement.

still_verified: Author scan/specimen IDs and S,N exist in the public readme.
P5 stress is a range and R=0.1; amplitude conversion remains Δσ/2.
The29 retained as-built records preserve raw outcomes; µ15 remains excluded for the existing stress conflict.

missing_fields.needed: For at least6 named usable specimens in one condition: actual build identifier per ID, or an explicit source statement naming that exact set as one physical build. A statement that48 specimens were manufactured is insufficient.
Powder lot per build or an explicit common-lot statement covering those exact specimens. Oerlikon Metco is a supplier, not a powder-lot identifier.
Explicit RT or measured temperature applying to the named set; do not infer from unstated ambient conditions.
Explicit force/stress control and virgin constant-amplitude protocol for the named set. Do not import18Hz or other Methods from Publication4.

impasse_assessment.diller_public_chain: The accessible dissertation, current deposited table and official student-work catalog do not contain the missing crosswalk. The only linked richer repository requires login; catalog access is by secretariat. Repeating these public reads cannot manufacture the missing fields.
impasse_assessment.what_would_change_status: A public authorized build/method crosswalk, publicly released student thesis/appendix, or user-authorized source clarification. No contact has been made.
impasse_assessment.bounded_claim: This is an impasse for this verified public source chain, not proof that no relevant file exists anywhere.
